rules.description: Applicant must be an EU, EEA or Swiss national, or a family member of one
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be from the EU, EEA or Switzerland, or be the family member of someone who is

rules.description: Applicant or their family member must have been living in UK by 31 December 2020
rules.reason_if_failed: You or your family member must have been living in the UK by 31 December 2020

rules.description: Applicant must apply by their relevant deadline or have reasonable grounds for delay
rules.reason_if_failed: You have not applied by your deadline and have not shown reasonable grounds for the delay

rules.description: Applicant must provide valid passport or national identity card (or BRC if non-EU)
rules.reason_if_failed: You must provide a valid identity document

rules.description: For settled status, applicant must have 5 years continuous residence (at least 6 months per year)
rules.reason_if_failed: You do not have 5 years continuous residence. You may be eligible for pre-settled status instead.

rules.description: Applicant must not have serious or repeated criminal convictions or pose security threat
rules.reason_if_failed: Your application cannot be granted due to serious criminality or security concerns

rules.description: If applying as family member, relationship must have existed by 31 Dec 2020 and still exist (unless child born/adopted after)
rules.reason_if_failed: Your family relationship does not meet the requirements for this scheme

explanation_template: EU Settlement Scheme eligibility: {outcome}. Status type: {status_type}

edge_cases.description: Applicant is a victim of domestic violence or abuse in relationship with EU/EEA/Swiss national
edge_cases.action: May be eligible for settled status without 5 years continuous residence. Route to specialist caseworker for assessment. Supporting evidence from domestic violence organisation required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant had to stop working due to accident, illness or occupational disease
edge_cases.action: May be eligible for settled status with less than 5 years residence. Medical evidence and proof of work-related accident or occupational disease pension required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is child of EU/EEA/Swiss national who worked in UK and left, and child is in education
edge_cases.action: Special eligibility rules apply. Parent is also eligible. Evidence of parent's former work and current education enrollment required. Cannot use online service - contact Resolution Centre.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is primary carer of British citizen (Zambrano case)
edge_cases.action: Limited eligibility - must have entered UK with specific EU Settlement Scheme family permit. Cannot use online service. Contact Resolution Centre for specialist application form.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is family member of eligible person of Northern Ireland with compelling reasons they could not return by deadline
edge_cases.action: Different eligibility pathway. Must prove family member born in NI with qualifying parent citizenship. Evidence of compelling practical/compassionate reasons required.

edge_cases.description: Parent/guardian failed to apply for child by deadline
edge_cases.action: Child may have reasonable grounds for late application even if parent does not. Assess child's circumstances separately. Social services involvement may be required.

edge_cases.description: Applicant already has ILE/ILR since before 31 Dec 2020
edge_cases.action: Not required to apply but can choose to. If granted, will get settled status with 5-year (not 2-year) absence allowance. Advantageous for frequent travellers.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is/was exempt from immigration control (diplomat, NATO member)
edge_cases.action: Can apply at any time. Family members can apply regardless of exemption status. Privileges and immunities may change if settled status granted.

edge_cases.description: Applicant was outside UK for more than 6-12 months due to COVID-19
edge_cases.action: May not break continuous residence if absence was COVID-related. Evidence of COVID impact on travel or circumstances required. Each case assessed individually.
